question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, 
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_from_batsmen,
           SUM(er.extra_runs) as runs_from_extras
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_avg AS (
    SELECT br.bowler, 
           br.runs_from_batsmen + COALESCE(br.runs_from_extras, 0) as total_runs,
           bw.wickets,
           (br.runs_from_batsmen + COALESCE(br.runs_from_extras, 0)) / NULLIF(bw.wickets, 0) as bowling_average
    FROM bowler_runs br
    JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
)
SELECT p.player_name, ba.total_runs, ba.wickets, ba.bowling_average
FROM bowler_avg ba
JOIN player p ON ba.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY ba.bowling_average ASC
